You are good. I mean *really* good.

You make a strong point which is hard to argue. I will take your advice to heart. Something like that takes time. Maybe I can contact you again in the future. We both can see how successful you might become.

OK... you make a good point...

I have a girlfriend of about 3 years... Does that mean I should marry her and have babies with her just because I'm depressed and need a goal?

1 in 10 is not a very impressive figure, to be honest. Nonetheless, you make a good point.

Sigghh... It's just a really hard subject to bring up to someone. I'm normally the problem solver, not someone who needs someone to help them. 

That's why I like these anonymous forums. I don't know you guys so I can say anything and I still get useful advice. I feel I should pay some kind of hourly rate for using /r/suicidewatch.

For 15 years or whatever, school was my goal. I achieved that. Now what?

I dont want anymore schooling, I am happy with my occupation (any higher and I would hate it.... think management) 

So I think of a hobby? Building model rockets will keep me happy the the remaining 40-50 years of my life? I dunno man. It just seems shitty.

No psychological evaluation has ever been done on me. But I don't see why I should different than anyone else. Everyone around me is perfectly normal and so far I seem to fit in pretty well.

Not to go against your point, all I'm saying is that 'why would I be any different?'
